yt_title: How Many Neck Bones Does A Giraffe Have? #Shorts
desc: A giraffe has seven neck bones, the same number as a human. Each one can be nearly ten inches long. New fizzy fact every day on Fruit Soda.
caption: Seven neck bones, same as you! 🦒 Did you know that? Comment YES or NO. Follow for a fact every day. Send this to a friend.

lines.text: How many neck bones does a giraffe have? The same as you.
Seven. Humans have seven neck bones, and so does a giraffe.
Its bones are just huge. Some are nearly ten inches long.
Nearly every mammal, from mice to whales, has seven.
So the tallest animal on land has the same count as a mouse. Seven.
